meta.title: Pricing - NIS2 Compliance Platform
meta.description: The platform is free, permanently. Hosted at nisd2.eu, or self-hosted on your own infrastructure, source open under AGPL-3.0. No contract, no activation, no lock-in.

paid.name: NIS 2 guided pass
paid.moneyBackDetail: On your first order you can cancel for 30 days without giving a reason, under Billing or by email. We cancel the invoice. If you have already paid, we refund the full amount within 30 days. Your data stays stored. Does not apply to renewals.
paid.terms: By invoice, due in 30 days. Cancel within the first 30 days: invoice cancelled or money back.

features.guided: Guided NIS 2 implementation, step by step
features.history: A history of changes and sign-offs to show your regulator
features.deadlines: Deadlines and reminders for each requirement
features.export: Export to PDF or CSV at any time

paid.grandfatheredNote: Signed in before paid plans started? You pay {price} net a year, renewals included.

features.h5: Export your work from nisd2.eu and carry on running it yourself

pricing.whyFree: Why free: the source is open on GitHub, auditable and yours to run. We charge for setting up self-hosted installations, and we take a commission from the specialist firms we refer you to. Not for the platform.
pricing.consultantFootnote: Stuck with NIS 2? Short technical questions cost nothing, and if it needs a specialist firm, we refer you to one at no cost to you.
